images.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent hand skin atlas for a 2D skeletal tarot dealer. The reference image supplies ONLY painterly style, skin tones and lighting. Output ONE transparent PNG atlas, EXACTLY six equal columns and two equal rows, no margins between the equal cell grid but generous transparent padding INSIDE every cell. Each cell contains exactly ONE isolated painted anatomical part. Row 1 is the viewer-left palm-up hand, row 2 is its viewer-right counterpart. In BOTH rows, columns in reading order: 1 isolated PALM AND WRIST ONLY with NO fingers and NO thumb, its wrist points up and softly rounded knuckle attachment bases point down; 2 isolated straight thumb, 3 isolated straight index finger, 4 isolated straight middle finger, 5 isolated straight ring finger, 6 isolated straight little finger. Every digit is an ENTIRE straight finger shown from its PALMAR surface, base at top, round tip at bottom, pointing straight downward. Paint clear natural skin creases and joints, subtle taper and soft edges, with uninterrupted flesh at each joint, no mechanical hinges. Keep a finger's flat cut attachment at the top, not a detached round floating nub. Palms have clean attachment points; do NOT paint any fingers onto the palm cells. These parts will be joined by code; separate them fully, never a full hand in any cell. NO sleeves, cuffs, rings, jewelry, text, numbers, labels, grid lines, extra arms, backdrop, opaque shadows or checkerboard. Warm candle light from viewer-left, subtle cool fill from viewer-right. Photorealistic cinematic painterly finish, preserve adult proportions, no cartoon, no baby hands, no skeletal bony or clawlike fingers, no bleeding or gore. Actual transparent alpha outside each part. Hands belong to an adult woman: elegant, healthy, softly full ivory-warm hands, slender natural fingers, short unpainted nails. Match the attached existing Star Moon hand textures.
images.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this existing transparent skeletal hand atlas. Keep the EXACT six-column, two-row layout, exact positions and sizes of ALL twelve isolated parts, skin color, painterly texture, alpha transparency and lighting. Change ONLY the separated finger parts in columns 2–6 of both rows: they must show the PALMAR / fingerprint-pad side. REMOVE ALL fingernails and nail beds, replacing those visible nails with soft rounded fleshy fingertip pads and subtle fingerprint/skin crease texture. A palm-up hand must not have nails on its palm-facing fingers. Keep every digit fully straight, base at top, rounded fingertip at bottom, anatomical taper. Keep the two palm/wrist cells in column 1 completely unchanged. No cuffs, extra fingers, text, labels, backgrounds, grid lines, shadows or checkerboard. Production reusable PNG with genuine transparency.
